# Santhosh S — Video Editor & Creative Content Creator

> Professional Video Editor with 2+ years of experience turning raw footage into cinematic visual stories. Specializing in wedding films, Instagram Reels, promotional videos, trailers, and event highlights.

## About
Santhosh S is an India-based creative video editor with expertise in narrative storytelling, cinematic color grading, sound design, and viral short-form social video creation.

## Key Skills & Specialties
- **Wedding Film Editing**: Cinematic wedding films, emotional highlights, teasers, multi-camera audio sync.
- **Instagram Reels & YouTube Shorts**: High-retention pacing, speed ramps, kinetic typography, beat synchronization.
- **Promotional & Commercials**: Brand teasers, product launch films, trailer editing.
- **Event Videos**: Birthdays, baby showers, special celebrations.
- **Post-Production Techniques**: Color correction, film emulation LUTs, audio syncing, sound effects, motion graphics.
- **AI & Emerging Tech**: AI-assisted video editing, prompt engineering, generative workflows.
